description: IoT Village at DEF CON 24 explores security research, vulnerability disclosure, and exploitation techniques across embedded devices, wireless protocols, and connected hardware.

talks.teaser: A technical examination of security vulnerabilities, reverse engineering, and protocol exploitation in connected consumer IoT devices.
